entries.title: According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?
entries.text: According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France? [A] Physical beauty would be redefined. [B] New runways would be constructed. 将修建新的跑道。 [C] Websites about dieting would thrive. 减肥类网站会兴盛。 [D] The fashion industry would decline. 时装业将会衰退。 答案 A According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?根据第一段，法国会发生什么？ [A] Physical beauty would be redefined. [B] New runways would be constructed.将修建新的跑道。 [C] Websites about dieting would thrive.减肥类网站会兴盛。 [D] The fashion industry would decline.时装业将会衰退。 💡 考场思路首段：fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women——时尚业不再能定义美，即形体美将被重新定义。 逐项分析 [A] 形体美将被重新定义 → 正确； [B] 新建T台 → 无中生有； [C] 节食网站繁荣 → 与 ban websites 相反； [D] 时尚业衰退 → 过度推断。 核心词汇 preliminary adj. 初步的 incite v. 煽动 impinge on 损害 arbiter n. 评判者 intangible adj. 无形的 sanction n. 制裁

entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, the achievements of the National Trust are now being ___. [A] gradually destroyed. [B] effectively reinforced. 得到有效强化。 [C] properly protected. 得到妥善保护。 [D] largely overshadowed. 在很大程度上被遮蔽。 答案 A According to Paragraph 2, the achievements of the National Trust are now being ___.根据第2段，国家信托基金的成就现在是___。 [A] gradually destroyed. [B] effectively reinforced.得到有效强化。 [C] properly protected.得到妥善保护。 [D] largely overshadowed.在很大程度上被遮蔽。 💡 考场思路第二段：concrete consumes more of it——混凝土在吞噬乡村，即国民信托的成果正被逐渐破坏。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3? [A] Labour is under attack for opposing development. 工党因反对开发而受到抨击。 [B] The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building. 保守党可能放弃“期房”建设。 [C] Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation. [D] The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence. 自由民主党正失去政治影响力。 答案 C Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?从第3款中可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Labour is under attack for opposing development.工党因反对开发而受到抨击。 [B] The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building.保守党可能放弃“期房”建设。 [C] Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation. [D] The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence.自由民主党正失去政治影响力。 💡 考场思路第三段：Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for...——独立党嗅到机会站到保护乡村一边，暗示它可能从中获益。

entries.title: The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___.
entries.text: The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___. [A] reveals a strong prejudice against urban areas. 流露出对城市地区的强烈偏见。 [B] shows his disregard for the character of rural areas. [C] stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis. 强调缓解住房危机的必要性。 [D] highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure. 凸显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。 答案 B The author holds that George Osborne's preference ___.作者认为乔治·奥斯本的偏好___。 [A] reveals a strong prejudice against urban areas.流露出对城市地区的强烈偏见。 [B] shows his disregard for the character of rural areas. [C] stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.强调缓解住房危机的必要性。 [D] highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure.凸显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。 💡 考场思路第五段：奥斯本偏好乡村新建，而作者认为乡村发展应"stick to their edges and respect their character"——即奥斯本不尊重乡村特色。

entries.title: In the last paragraph, the author shows his appreciation of ___.
entries.text: In the last paragraph, the author shows his appreciation of ___. [A] the size of population in Britain. 英国的人口规模。 [B] the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain. 英国令人羡慕的城市生活方式。 [C] the town-and-country planning in Britain. [D] the political life in today's Britain. 当今英国的政治生活。 答案 C In the last paragraph, the author shows his appreciation of ___.在最后一段中，作者对___表示感谢。 [A] the size of population in Britain.英国的人口规模。 [B] the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain.英国令人羡慕的城市生活方式。 [C] the town-and-country planning in Britain. [D] the political life in today's Britain.当今英国的政治生活。 💡 考场思路末段：Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence——作者赞赏英国城乡规划。 核心词汇 let rip 放任自流 corrupted adj. 被破坏的 biased adj. 有偏向的 lobby n. 游说集团

entries.title: The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___.
entries.text: The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___. [A] uncertainty. 不确定性。 [B] skepticism. [C] approval. 批准；赞成。 [D] tolerance. 宽容。 答案 B The author views Milton Friedman's statement about CSR with ___.作者将米尔顿·弗里德曼（ Milton Friedman ）关于企业社会责任的陈述与___一起查看。 [A] uncertainty.不确定性。 [B] skepticism. [C] approval.批准；赞成。 [D] tolerance.宽容。 💡 考场思路首段：even if you accept Friedman's premise...things may not be absolutely clear-cut——作者用 but 转折，暗示对弗里德曼观点的怀疑。 逐项分析 [A] 不确定 → 不是； [B] 怀疑 → 正确； [C] 赞同 → 与 but 相反； [D] 宽容 → 不符。 核心词汇 premise n. 前提 clear-cut adj. 绝对的 halo effect 光环效应 lenient adj. 宽大的 prosecute v. 起诉 bank on 指望

entries.title: According to Paragraph 2, CSR helps a company by ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 2, CSR helps a company by ___. [A] guarding it against malpractices. 防范其舞弊行为。 [B] protecting it from being defamed. 保护它免受诽谤。 [C] winning trust from consumers. [D] raising the quality of its products. 提升其产品质量。 答案 C According to Paragraph 2, CSR helps a company by ___.根据第2段， CSR通过___帮助公司。 [A] guarding it against malpractices.防范其舞弊行为。 [B] protecting it from being defamed.保护它免受诽谤。 [C] winning trust from consumers. [D] raising the quality of its products.提升其产品质量。 💡 考场思路第二段三种方式：信号、间接捐款、光环效应——都归结为赢得消费者信任。

entries.title: The expression "more lenient" (Para. 4) is closest in meaning to ___.
entries.text: The expression "more lenient" (Para. 4) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] less controversial. 争议较小的。 [B] more lasting. 更持久的。 [C] more effective. 更有效的。 [D] less severe. 答案 D The expression "more lenient" (Para. 4) is closest in meaning to ___.“更宽大” （第4段）在含义上最接近___。 [A] less controversial.争议较小的。 [B] more lasting.更持久的。 [C] more effective.更有效的。 [D] less severe. 💡 考场思路CSR全面的企业处罚更"宽大"——lenient = less severe（不那么严厉）。

entries.title: When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___.
entries.text: When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___. [A] comes across as reliable evidence. 看起来像是可靠的证据。 [B] has an impact on their decision. [C] increases the chance of being penalized. 增加了受处罚的几率。 [D] constitutes part of the investigation. 构成调查的一部分。 答案 B When prosecutors evaluate a case, a company's CSR record ___.当检察官评估案件时，公司的CSR记录___。 [A] comes across as reliable evidence.看起来像是可靠的证据。 [B] has an impact on their decision. [C] increases the chance of being penalized.增加了受处罚的几率。 [D] constitutes part of the investigation.构成调查的一部分。 💡 考场思路第五段：prosecutors do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR——CSR记录影响检察官决定。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of CSR, according to the last paragraph?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of CSR, according to the last paragraph? [A] The necessary amount of companies' spending on it is unknown. [B] Companies' financial capacity for it has been overestimated. 企业为其提供资金的财力被高估了。 [C] Its negative effects on businesses are often overlooked. 它对企业的负面影响常被忽视。 [D] It has brought much benefit to the banking industry. 它为银行业带来了诸多益处。 答案 A Which of the following is true of CSR, according to the last paragraph?根据最后一段，以下哪项对CSR来说是正确的？ [A] The necessary amount of companies' spending on it is unknown. [B] Companies' financial capacity for it has been overestimated.企业为其提供资金的财力被高估了。 [C] Its negative effects on businesses are often overlooked.它对企业的负面影响常被忽视。 [D] It has brought much benefit to the banking industry.它为银行业带来了诸多益处。 💡 考场思路末段：does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR——应该花多少还不清楚。 核心词汇 substantial adj. 重大的 merit n. 案情本身/优点 demonstrate v. 证明 diffuse adj. 广泛的

entries.title: The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___.
entries.text: The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___. [A] the increasing online ad sales. 日益增长的在线广告销售额。 [B] the pressure from its investors. 来自其投资者的压力。 [C] the complaints from its readers. 来自读者的投诉。 [D] the high cost of operation. 答案 D The New York Times is considering ending its print edition partly due to ___.《纽约时报》正在考虑结束其印刷版，部分原因是___。 [A] the increasing online ad sales.日益增长的在线广告销售额。 [B] the pressure from its investors.来自其投资者的压力。 [C] the complaints from its readers.来自读者的投诉。 [D] the high cost of operation. 💡 考场思路第二段：infrastructure isn't just expensive; it's excessive——运营成本高。 逐项分析 [A] 线上广告增长 → 原文 print ad sales still dwarf online，不是原因； [B] 投资者压力 → 未提及； [C] 读者抱怨 → 相反，忠实读者会不满； [D] 运营成本高 → 正确。 核心词汇 cease v. 停止 nostalgia n. 怀旧 ditch v. 抛弃 infrastructure n. 基础设施 circulation n. 发行量 foresighted adj. 有远见的

entries.title: Peretti suggests that, in face of the present situation, the Times should ___.
entries.text: Peretti suggests that, in face of the present situation, the Times should ___. [A] make strategic adjustments. [B] end the print edition for good. 永久停办纸质版。 [C] seek new sources of readership. 寻找新的读者来源。 [D] aim for efficient management. 以高效管理为目标。 答案 A Peretti suggests that, in face of the present situation, the Times should ___.Peretti建议，面对目前的情况，《纽约时报》应该___。 [A] make strategic adjustments. [B] end the print edition for good.永久停办纸质版。 [C] seek new sources of readership.寻找新的读者来源。 [D] aim for efficient management.以高效管理为目标。 💡 考场思路佩雷蒂说不要急着停掉，而要"go about doing it the right way"、提价做成legacy product——即做战略调整。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that a "legacy product" ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that a "legacy product" ___. [A] helps restore the glory of former times. 有助于恢复往昔的荣耀。 [B] is meant for the most loyal customers. [C] will have the cost of printing reduced. 将使印刷成本降低。 [D] expands the popularity of the paper. 扩大了该报的知名度。 答案 B It can be inferred from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that a "legacy product" ___.从第5段和第6段可以推断出“旧产品” ___。 [A] helps restore the glory of former times.有助于恢复往昔的荣耀。 [B] is meant for the most loyal customers. [C] will have the cost of printing reduced.将使印刷成本降低。 [D] expands the popularity of the paper.扩大了该报的知名度。 💡 考场思路第六段：make it for the people who are already obsessed with it——为痴迷它的人做，即最忠实顾客。

entries.title: Peretti believes that, in a changing world, ___.
entries.text: Peretti believes that, in a changing world, ___. [A] traditional luxuries can stay unaffected. 传统奢侈品可不受影响。 [B] cautiousness facilitates problem-solving. 谨慎有助于解决问题。 [C] aggressiveness better meets challenges. [D] legacy businesses are becoming outdated. 传统企业正变得过时。 答案 C Peretti believes that, in a changing world, ___.Peretti认为，在一个不断变化的世界中， ___。 [A] traditional luxuries can stay unaffected.传统奢侈品可不受影响。 [B] cautiousness facilitates problem-solving.谨慎有助于解决问题。 [C] aggressiveness better meets challenges. [D] legacy businesses are becoming outdated.传统企业正变得过时。 💡 考场思路末段：it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive——更激进更好。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title of the text? [A] Shift to Online Newspapers All at Once. 立即全面转向网络报纸。 [B] Cherish the Newspaper Still in Your Hand. 珍惜你手中尚存的报纸。 [C] Keep Your Newspapers Forever in Fashion. 让你的报纸永远时尚。 [D] Make Your Print Newspaper a Luxury Good. 答案 D Which of the following would be the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Shift to Online Newspapers All at Once.立即全面转向网络报纸。 [B] Cherish the Newspaper Still in Your Hand.珍惜你手中尚存的报纸。 [C] Keep Your Newspapers Forever in Fashion.让你的报纸永远时尚。 [D] Make Your Print Newspaper a Luxury Good. 💡 考场思路核心建议是把纸质版提价做成legacy/luxury product（500美元/年）。 核心词汇 aggressive adj. 激进的 subscription n. 订阅 revenue n. 收入 migration n. 迁移

entries.title: We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the sa
entries.text: We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone. We don't have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone. 我们的心理健康不是学来的；它是我们生来就有的，正如同我们的身体知道如何愈合伤口或修复断骨一样。 采分点① be built into us 内置于我们/天生具有；② heal a cut 愈合伤口；③ mend a broken bone 修复断骨。

entries.title: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it ca
entries.text: Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant. Our mental health doesn't really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant. 心理健康并没有真的离开；宛如云朵后面的太阳，它虽然可能暂离我们的视线，但完全能在转瞬之间重现。 采分点① temporarily hidden 暂时被遮蔽；② be capable of 能够；③ in an instant 瞬间。

entries.title: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles
entries.text: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are. Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are. 健康的心理让我们在他人遇到困难时心怀同情，遭受苦痛时心怀善意，不论他们是谁都心怀无条件的爱。 采分点① view others with sympathy 以同情看待他人；② unconditional love 无条件的爱。

entries.title: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ord
entries.text: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions. Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions. 尽管心理健康是我们生活的万能良药，但它又再寻常不过，因为你会发现，它一直在那里引领你完成所有艰难的抉择。 采分点① cure-all 万灵药；② perfectly ordinary 再寻常不过；③ direct you through 引领你度过。

entries.title: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and know
entries.text: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily. As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily. 你终会明白，懂得心理健康无时不在并懂得信赖它，这能让我们慢下来活在每一刻，快乐地生活着。 采分点① available 可获得的/存在的；② slow down to the moment 慢下来活在当下；③ live life happily 快乐地生活。

entries.title: Suppose you are a librarian at a university. Write a notice of about 100 words t
entries.text: Suppose you are a librarian at a university. Write a notice of about 100 words to new international students, providing information about the library. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 通知 原题指令 Directions Suppose you are a librarian at a university. Write a notice of about 100 words to new international students, providing information about the library. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】假设你是大学图书馆员。写一则约100词的通知，向新入学的留学生提供图书馆相关信息。通知末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 假设你是大学图书馆员。写一则约100词的通知，向新入学的国际学生提供图书馆相关信息。落款 Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：通知（NOTICE）；② 内容：开放时间、借阅规则、资源服务、培训等。 参考范文 NOTICE Welcome to our university! To help you make the most of the library, here is some essential information for new international students. The library is open from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on weekdays and from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on weekends. Each student may borrow up to five books for 30 days. With your student ID, you can also access our online databases and e-journals 24 hours a day. Picture: The left picture shows a father sitting on the sofa watching TV and shouting at his son, "Study hard!" while the son sits at his desk looking upset. The right picture shows the father and son both studying at their desks. The title is "Setting an example works better than mere demands". Part B 大作文（20分）— 图画作文《与其只提要求，不如做个榜样》 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The left picture shows a father sitting on the sofa watching TV and shouting at his son, "Study hard!" while the son sits at his desk looking upset. The title is "Setting an example works better than mere demands". 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答 图画描述 左图：父亲坐在沙发上看电视，对儿子喊"儿子，你给我好好学习！"，儿子坐在书桌前愁眉苦脸。右图：父子俩各自坐在书桌前认真学习。图题：与其只提要求，不如做个榜样。 审题框架 三段式：①简要描述图画（两种教育方式对比）；②阐释含义（身教重于言传、父母榜样的力量）；③给出评论。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon presents a thought-provoking contrast. In the left picture, a father lounges comfortably before the TV, shouting at his son to "study hard," while the boy looks worried; in the right picture, both father and son are reading diligently at their desks. The caption reads: "Rather than merely making demands, it is better to set an example." The drawing conveys a universal principle in education: parents should lead by example rather than by words.
